tagline: Act it, impersonate it, hum it

activities.name: Cameo
activities.howto: Charades. Act it out silently — no talking, no sound effects, no pointing at anything in the room.

activities.name: Copycat
activities.howto: Act and talk like them. You can speak — but never say their name, and no names of any kind.

activities.name: Humdinger
activities.howto: Hum the tune. No words, no lyrics, no tapping out the rhythm on the table.
